Font, FontFamily, FontFileUtil (device v: A native reads a font file's bytes through a pinned array's address (VMRuntime.addressOf of a direct buffer's byte[], memory.ts NM_BASE) that only Memory.peek and poke understand: the production natives know native-heap addresses (B3, jnio and jmemory).
Paint, TextPaint, PathEffects, MaskFilte: PathIterator.nNext writes into the float[8] whose address is the handle VMRuntime.addressOf gave; the handle is a copy of the array, not the array, so Java reads zeros (B3).
Path, PathMeasure, PathIterator (device: As for Paint: PathIterator.nNext writes to a copy of the pinned float[8] (B3).
Region, RegionIterator (device values): Region.getBoundaryPath reads its verbs through PathIterator, whose points array is a copy (B3).
SurfaceTexture: states, errors and frame: The frame reaches the listener through the main thread's Handler, which needs the main looper running; the loop on a strand is Track C3's.
ImageDecoder: headers, targets, allocato: The exercise implements OnHeaderDecodedListener with a host object (harness listener: implement on a made Object); a host object of no registered class is no Java object, so the interface method is abstract to the framework (B2).
SpannableStringBuilder, SpannableString,: The exercise implements SpanWatcher and TextWatcher with host objects (harness listener); as for ImageDecoder (B2).
ApkAssets + AssetManager.Builder + Resou: Reports a facade read of BootClassLoader.runtime: the DexFile spec (jdex.ts) reads rt.classLoader.runtime, the JS tier's loader object, which a Java class loader is not (B2).
Theme.obtainStyledAttributes (ApplyStyle: ApplyStyle writes its results through TypedArray's native address (VMRuntime.addressOf of an int[]), the handle of a copy, so Java reads the defaults (B3).
Resources.getColorStateList (inflated fr: Attributes arrive through TypedArray's native address as above (B3).
VectorDrawable: inflated tree, node prop: Attributes arrive through TypedArray's native address as above, so the drawable's resource id reads as 0x1 (B3).
InputProbe: MotionEvent, VelocityTracker: Host code constructs webdroid/InputManagerService, a class the host implements, with a constructor argument; entry newObj knows only bytecode constructors (B2).
